dataset.name: Big Ten adjuvant durvalumab esophagogastric cohort (GSE183924)
dataset.description: Independent esophageal and gastroesophageal-junction adenocarcinoma trial cohort with direct bulk RNA sequencing and individual relapse-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The multicenter phase II BTCRC-ESO14-012 trial enrolled 37 patients with locally advanced esophageal or gastroesophageal-junction adenocarcinoma, residual disease after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection, and adjuvant durvalumab treatment. TRACE Explorer retains one banked FFPE tumor RNA profile for each enrolled patient.
dataset.publication_citation: Mamdani et al. Frontiers in Oncology 2021

metadata.source_program: Big Ten Cancer Research Consortium BTCRC-ESO14-012 phase II trial
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus plus the open-access article
metadata.library_method: RNA from banked FFPE tumor blocks, TruSeq RNA Exome libraries, STAR alignment to hg38, featureCounts quantification and source-provided edgeR FPKM
metadata.endpoint_context: Relapse-free survival from esophageal surgery among patients treated with postoperative durvalumab
metadata.endpoint_caveat: This is a single-arm treatment-selected cohort with residual disease after trimodality therapy. Associations are conditional on trial eligibility and adjuvant durvalumab exposure and should not be generalized as untreated-disease prognosis.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned GEO XLSX supplies a unique patient identifier, RNA-seq identifier, surgery date, source RFS time and source event indicator for all 37 GEO samples.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Every GEO record contributes one tumor profile and maps one-to-one to a clinical record. The source FPKM matrix contains two additional RNA columns, SL446520 and SL462110, without GEO sample or clinical records; they are excluded by deterministic linkage.
metadata.overlap_note: The prospective Big Ten trial cohort is independent of TCGA-ESCA and of the other ESCA cohorts represented in TRACE Explorer. Releases remain separate and are never pooled by default.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Banked FFPE esophageal or gastroesophageal-junction adenocarcinoma tissue from a trial participant

expression.label: GEO FPKM transformed to log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.source_unit: Gene-level FPKM supplied by the source study
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GEO FPKM matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 28,058 non-empty source symbols are case-insensitively unique, so no feature collapse or exclusion is required.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer selects the 37 patient-linked RNA columns from the 39-column source FPKM matrix and applies log2(FPKM + 1).

endpoints.label: Relapse-free survival from surgery
endpoints.event_definition: Disease relapse by RECIST 1.1 or death from any cause; patients alive and relapse-free are censored at the last disease evaluation
